title: Small Ext with canonical sheaf abelian structures
statement: For every scheme W and commutative ring R in the sheaf universe, abelian sheaves and R-module-valued pro-etale sheaves on W have small Ext groups with the named canonical abelian structures of [def-sfb-diagonal-system-interface]. The existing smallness witnesses [def-sfb-geo-cartier-interface] apply because the named structures have the same operations. Record the results as proved theorems with those canonical structures in their types, so later proofs can share the checked coefficient types.

source.place: Canonical coefficient structures in the diagonal tower proof and the existing Cartier coefficient smallness witnesses.

proof.text: Use the named canonical module-sheaf and abelian-sheaf structures of the diagonal interface; they have the same operations as the underlying sheaf abelian structures.

Apply geoCartierModuleExt and geoCartierIntegralExt respectively. Definitional equality of the canonical operations identifies their propositions with the required small-Ext propositions. These are proved theorem constants, not reducible aliases or additional category structures.
